description: This file defines the interface for the IHeartbeatProcedure and its factory within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It declares methods for creating heartbeat handlers and procedures, and references external classes IAckSender and IHeartbeatHandler.

classes.name: IHeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Interface for heartbeat procedures, providing a method to create heartbeat handlers.

classes.name: IHeartbeatProcedureFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating IHeartbeatProcedure instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create a new factory instance for heartbeat procedures.

methods.name: createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new heartbeat procedure with the given acknowledgment sender and ping ID.

methods.name: createHandler
methods.description: Creates a heartbeat handler for a specific control ID.
